name: Sihaya Ridge
text:
Add:
*6 spice* on Sihaya Ridge
*Hiereg token* on Cielago East
about: Discovery blow. Destroy all existing spice and forces throughout Sihaya Ridge, including Fremen and Bene Gesserit advisors. Place 6 spice in its only sector unless that sector is in storm. Place one random Hiereg token face down in Cielago East, west sector. Fremen may inspect that token at any time without revealing it. Other factions with non-advisor forces there may inspect and optionally reveal it during Spice Collection. The blow and token have separate locations; destruction applies to the blow territory, not the token territory.
